ModMetaData.name: Prepatcher (1.7)
ModMetaData.author: Zetrith, 1.7 port by Ren
ModMetaData.description:
Zetrith's Prepatcher, patched up for 1.7. Work in progress, don't subscribe expecting it to just work.
What's done: it reads assemblies off disk instead of out of Mono, finds them in the game root, parks the loading thread instead of aborting it, and no longer bundles Harmony, so get the Harmony mod and let it load above this one.
What isn't: 1.7's engine reads the map and camera straight out of Assembly-CSharp and binds to it before any mod loads, so once Prepatcher swaps in its patched copy the game renders a black map. Everything else runs, the sim is fine, you just can't see it. Patching the assembly on disk instead works, but that needs a restart and regenerating whenever the mod list changes, and I haven't built that properly yet.
Also makes a failed Harmony patch skip itself instead of taking the whole mod down with it. Harmony 3 is stricter than 2.x and a fair few mods trip it.
All Zetrith's work, I only fixed what 1.7 broke. If he wants this down or puts out his own build, say so and I'll remove it.
